spiritgiven.comments: There were small rules things that they didn’t know (changing places on the line, changing pivot feet, traveling when bringing the disc to the front of the endzone), but we felt they were not enough to give them a 1. For communication, we understand that it’s hard to bring the translator every thing there’s a discussion, but we think they could have used more hand signals and they were stalling in Japanese sometimes. We thought their fair mindedness and attitude were very spirited! Great game!!!
Very well spirited team, they were always smiling and a joy to play against. Great game Ireland!!!!
This was a great game! Great spirit, communication, and knowledge! We thank them for the amazing game and wish them the best of luck the rest of the tournament.
They were knowledgeable of the rules and the called were resolved fairly quickly despite some language barriers. They were always smiling and we wish them the best of luck the rest of the tournament!
Such a good game! A little physical on both sides, but not enough for a 1. Great game either way, hope to see them again!
Communication was great, and a clean game! Thanks GB
Stall count came it at the wrong count after fouls, lots of contract, sideline (coaches) had strong reactions to calls. But the communication was good!
Great game USA! Sorry for the contact
Lots of contact and we told them at halftime, but it was a lot better after. The communication was good and there was good spirit on the sideline.
When there were calls, they took a lot of time to resolve.

spiritreceived.comments: There was a praise when the both team played a good play so it was a good spirit!
High Complements from the team of the teams speed, teamwork, layouts and completed passes. We really enjoyed the game and the spirit the team brought. We wish you look for the rest of the tournament.
Appreciate the check in when one of my teammates got injured
Great game and super intense! We noticed negative attitude towards us on the sideline and on the field every time we would call fouls or picks… everything else was fine.
There was a lot of contact and foul calls made during this game. Even though the game was very intense, there should have been a stronger focus on maintaining less body contact.

Double teams occured often and were not fixed after several discussions about it. Many foul and contact calls were made which resulted in long discussions where the unbiased (GA or video) decision was rarely accepted. The frequency of calls led to disrupted momentum of points. There were also several occurrences where they did not understand the rules which led to unnecessarily long discussions. We wish this final could have felt more spirited for how special of a game it should be.
